how.title: How voting works
how.registerBody: Turned 18? Fill in Form 6 on the <link>Voters' Service Portal</link>.
how.boothBody: The same search shows your polling booth. Your voter slip names it too.
how.voteBody: Take your voter ID card (EPIC) or another photo ID the Election Commission accepts. Press the button next to your choice.
how.helpline: Any questions? Call the voter helpline <call>{number}</call>.

calendar.daysAway: {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} away
calendar.expectedHint: This is an estimate from the last election and the length of the term. The exact date comes when the Election Commission announces it.
calendar.liveNote: During the election period, leadership data may change quickly. Party links and positions are shown as last reported.
calendar.disclaimer: Election dates and schedules come from the Election Commission of India (eci.gov.in). ForThePeople.in is an independent citizen transparency platform. It is not linked to, supported by, or acting for the Election Commission of India or any political party, and it is not an official election information portal. For official election information, visit <link>eci.gov.in</link> or contact your District Election Officer.

booth.lead: Tap a booth to see its details and get directions.
booth.hint: Your booth is printed on your voter slip and shown in the voter-list search. Check the address before you go.
